verdict.rationale: BigCommerce advertises a marketplace of over 1,200 apps, and its developer docs describe building single-click apps for that marketplace, so the core of the story (extending a store from an app marketplace) is clearly delivered. One community user called the app ecosystem 'rather incomplete'; this is vague, dated sentiment rather than a concrete counter-example, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: evidence that marketplace apps are vetted or reviewed, independent corroboration that the catalog covers long-tail features, and in-depth first-party documentation of the marketplace itself.
